## Developer problem

What are you trying to build, and what is difficult today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful API or documentation change. A short Swift usage sketch is welcome.

## API reference

For a MoMo operation, link the relevant official MTN documentation and note the product, request/response shape, auth requirements, and whether status is asynchronous.

## Alternatives or open questions

What tradeoffs should maintainers consider?
